description: This Java class, named DOMHelper, provides utility methods to simplify reading and extracting data from org.w3c.dom Node objects, including text extraction and attribute parsing with default value handling.

classes.name: DOMHelper
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to help extract text and attributes from XML DOM nodes.

methods.name: unmarshallText
methods.description: Extracts and concatenates text content from a given Node, skipping non-text nodes.

methods.name: unmarshallAttribute (String return)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a named attribute from a Node; returns default if missing.

methods.name: unmarshallAttribute (Double return)
methods.description: Retrieves and parses a named attribute as a Double, with default fallback.

methods.name: unmarshallAttribute (int return)
methods.description: Retrieves and parses a named attribute as an int, with default fallback.

methods.name: unmarshallAttribute (boolean return)
methods.description: Retrieves and parses a named attribute as a boolean, with default fallback.
